releaseNotes: Persistent Data Retention: Delivery details, assigned tasks, completion status, and Tour Plans are permanently retained across APK updates and server reconnects
Cloud PostgreSQL Sync: Direct real-time synchronization of monthly tour plans and orders to Supabase cloud storage
Offline Storage Hardening: Integrated native AsyncStorage for resilient local caching across all task and tour plan workflows
In-Place Update Support: Automated release signing guarantees seamless in-place APK installation without uninstalling or wiping device data
